content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: the top-level \"Trades\" span in the IR Swap navigation does not navigate on click; in both windows the Trades span clicks are followed by no navigation or overlay, and the screen only changes after a \"menuitem\" click (S14f12e28 event 56, S1ecbb600 event 88), which suggests Trades opens a submenu whose open state is not visibly signalled.", "fix": "Fix: In the IR Swap top navigation, make the \"Trades\" span/button either navigate directly on click or show a clear open state (aria-expanded and a highlighted, visibly open submenu) so the click on \"Trades\" produces a visible change, instead of relying on the user to click a menuitem afterwards.", "cited_event_ids": ["15", "41", "47", "56", "61:w62", "app:6", "16", "42", "48", "78", "88", "93:w112", "app:8"], "confidence": "low", "unsupported": ["No DOM or menu-state data confirming whether a submenu opened or stayed hidden after the Trades clicks.", "Dropped pointer samples (90 and 127) leave gaps in hover/position evidence.", "The 5.2 s median loss and 'no visible state change' come from the insight facts; the windows show no visible change but do not directly prove it.", "Whether the overlay shown after the menuitem click is the cause of the delayed navigation is not verified."]}
